name: AHR-1229
summary: AHR-1229, also known as N-butyl-N-(1-phenylpyrrolidin-4-yl)tryptamine, is a drug of the tryptamine family which was studied as a possible dopamine antagonist. It increases alertness and produces "small repetitive head movements" in rodents, effects said to be indicative of behavioral excitation, whereas it modestly antagonizes intra-accumbens dopamine-induced hyperlocomotion.
